messages:
Mika: Heads-up — mobile SDK 1.7.2 sometimes strips `X-RW-Client-Version` on retry, we get routing entropy for v2. small spike but persistent.
Sam: ugh. repro steps?
Mika: on flaky network flows: send request -> 500 -> retry path calls http.Client without header copy. I can paste stack trace.
Sam: can you paste minimal log? also what's the % of requests missing header?
Mika: ~0.3% globally, up to 1.2% for a t2 tenant. logs:
```
WARN request_id=abc123 missing header X-RW-Client-Version on retry
stack=github.com/redwood/... retry.go:58
```
Anya: well that's bad for sticky routing. we should have a fallback playbook: if header missing, consult token->pinned-version map in routing table, else sample to fallback-route.
Mika: agreed. proposed quick fix: server-side ensure we consider `client_metadata.version` from auth token if header absent.
Sam: long-term need SDK fix; short-term fallback rules ok. But telemetry to measure user impact first.
Console UX: we can add a per-tenant "version hydration" metric and surface a badge: "Client version complete | partial | missing". PR sketch for query:
```
-- console metric
SELECT tenant, count(*) as total, sum(case when header_present=1 then 1 else 0 end) as header_ok
FROM request_events
GROUP BY tenant
```
Console UX: badge color logic: missing > 5% => red, 1-5% => amber, else green.
Dave: ops question: rolling this out will need a config toggle and a canary. Suggest: feature flag `server:client-header-fallback` default off, enable for 5 tenants then ramp.
Anya: for telemetry sampling, propose 0.1% full trace of fallback cases + 5% lightweight counters. also tag traces with `fallback_source=header_absent`.
Sam: need safe fallback mapping: map to tenant's last-known version -> route to compatible model variant. No automatic jump to newest v2 for old tenants.
Mika: will open an RFC with the playbook steps and a small k8s deploy to set flag. including a tiny #[deploy-bot] check.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment requested by Mika: service/routing-v2 fallback-feature toggle=on for namespace=canary-tenants. started at 2026-03-20T15:04:00Z
infra-watchdog: noticed increased fallback events for canary tenant: 12 hits in 10m, sampling TTL ok.
Sam: ok patch incoming. SDK PR link: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/612 — will add header copy in retry client. ETA EOD.
Mika: thx. next steps: SDK patch, server toggle + console metric, canary ramp to 5% of tenants, then 100% after 48h if stability metrics ok. I'll post RFC link shortly.
Anya: also add alert: if fallback_rate > 2% for more than 30m, page eng-oncall.
Dave: noted. :thumbsup: 
Mika: filing thread summary and RFC -> will ping infra and console owners.
